## Description

SECURITY.md (reporting, supported versions), code review rules (security-sensitive code reviewed by hand, per Build Plan advice), synthetic-only test data policy (no real data in repo, CI, fixtures, AI evals), privileged access via just-in-time elevation (Entra PIM or documented manual JIT) and an offline break-glass account procedure stored outside the system.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** SECURITY.md, docs/compliance/secure-development.md and the synthetic data policy exist and are linked from README.
- [ ] **AC2.** PIM/JIT configuration (or documented procedure) means no standing Owner/Contributor or DB admin access in production.
- [ ] **AC3.** Break-glass account exists, is excluded from conditional access only as documented, credentials stored offline, and its use triggers an alert.
- [ ] **AC4.** A CI check rejects fixture files containing patterns of real national IDs (e.g. valid Aadhaar checksum) or obvious real data markers.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
